app.name: Kvito
app.headline:
Simple rental
management.
app.lead: Rent, bills and messages between landlord and tenant in one place.

common.offline: You're offline. Showing the last data we have.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.passwordRule: At least {{min}} characters. Avoid simple ones like 12345678.

register.title: New account
register.hint: Create an account. We send a code to your e-mail to confirm it.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.hint: We sent a code to {{email}}. Enter it and your account is ready.

forgot.title: New password
forgot.hint: Enter your account's e-mail. We'll send you a code for a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.hint: If there is an account for {{email}}, we sent it a code. Enter it and pick a new password.

auth.codeValidity: The code is valid for 15 minutes. Only the latest code works.
auth.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.devHint: Development: no e-mail is sent. The code is in the server terminal, in the last “E-mail for {{email}}” block.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

onboarding.title: What brings you to Kvito?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick where you start. You can add the other role any time.
onboarding.landlordHint: Post rent and bills, confirm payments and talk to your tenants.
onboarding.tenantHint: See what to pay and by when, report payments and message your landlord.

addRole.LANDLORD: I also rent out a property

home.landlordIntro: Set up your rental in three steps.

landlordSteps.property: Add a property and its units
landlordSteps.propertyHint: The address and the flats you rent out.
landlordSteps.tenancyHint: Rent, payment day, deposit and your IBAN.
landlordSteps.inviteHint: Send a link or show a QR code. No app install needed.

home.comingSoon: These steps arrive in the next Kvito update.
home.tenantBody: Send your landlord your e-mail so they can invite you. Once you accept, rent, bills and messages show up here.

install.iosTitle: Add Kvito to your Home Screen
install.iosBody: It's the only way your iPhone can send you reminders. In Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.updateAvailable: A new version of Kvito is available.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be outdated or mistyped.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check what you entered. Something is missing or in the wrong format.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests at once. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you don't have access.
errors.PROPERTY_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANCY: The property has an active tenancy. End it first.
errors.UNIT_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANCY: The unit already has an active tenancy.
errors.TENANCY_HAS_CHARGES: The tenancy has charges, so it can't be deleted. You can end it.
errors.INVITE_ACCEPTED: The invitation has already been accepted.
errors.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: The invitation is for a different e-mail.
errors.INVITE_OWN_PROPERTY: You can't accept your own invitation as a tenant.
errors.SHARES_INVALID: Tenant shares don't add up to 100 %. Edit them under Details.
errors.NO_MEMBERS: The tenancy has no tenants yet. Invite one first.
errors.CHARGE_LOCKED: This charge already has reported or confirmed payments, so it can't be changed.
errors.TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: That's not possible in the current state.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: You can upload a PDF or an image (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC).
errors.ATTACHMENT_INVALID: The attachment can't be used. Upload it again.
errors.SUPPLIER_PAYEE_REQUIRED: Enter the supplier's name and IBAN.
errors.FILE_LINK_EXPIRED: The file link expired. Refresh the page.
errors.LINK_INVALID: The link to a charge or repair is not valid.
errors.INVALID_METER_VALUE: The meter reading is not valid.
errors.PART_OF_HANDOVER: This reading is part of a handover record.
errors.HANDOVER_LOCKED: The record is awaiting confirmation or confirmed, so it can't be changed.
errors.HANDOVER_EMPTY: The record is empty. Add at least one item.
errors.DEPOSIT_NOT_AGREED: No deposit is set. Add it to the tenancy terms first.
errors.DEPOSIT_LOCKED: The deposit is already paid or reported, so the request can't be withdrawn.
errors.DEDUCTIONS_EXCEED_DEPOSIT: The amounts kept are higher than the deposit.
errors.DEDUCTION_INVALID: Each amount kept must be more than zero.
errors.HANDOVER_ITEM_INVALID: That handover item belongs to another tenancy.
errors.CHARGE_MANAGED: Change this charge in the Contract tab.
errors.SETTLEMENT_LOCKED: The settlement has been sent, so it can't be changed now.
errors.DUE_DATE_REQUIRED: The tenant will pay the difference. Enter a due date.
errors.MONTH_IN_PAST: You can schedule a change from this month on.
errors.RENT_ALREADY_CREATED: This month's rent has already been created. Choose the next month.
errors.RENT_CHANGE_APPLIED: The change is already in effect, so it can't be cancelled.
errors.STATEMENT_EMPTY: The file has no transactions. Choose a statement from your e-bank.
errors.STATEMENT_UNREADABLE: We can't read this file. Use a camt.053 (XML) or CSV statement from your e-bank.
errors.COST_ENTRY_LOCKED: This month is part of a settlement that was sent, so it can no longer change.
errors.CREDIT_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Choose what should happen with the credit.
errors.MONTH_BEFORE_START: The tenancy started later. Pick a month from the start of the tenancy on.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LONG: Pick at most 36 months at once.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The e-mail or password is not right.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this e-mail already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.WRONG_PASSWORD: The current password is not right.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your account isn't confirmed yet. We sent you a new code.
errors.CODE_INVALID: The code doesn't match or has expired. Enter the latest code.
errors.CODE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
errors.CODE_RATE_LIMITED: We've sent 5 codes in the last hour. Enter the latest one or try again in an hour.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes or set a new one via “Forgot your password?”.
errors.TOO_MANY_LINKS: You already have 10 valid links. Revoke one of them.

validation.amount: Enter an amount, for example 650 or 650.50.
validation.dueDay: Enter a day of the month from 1 to 31.
validation.INVALID_IBAN: The IBAN is not valid. Check the digits.
validation.END_BEFORE_START: The end must be after the start.
validation.INVALID_REFERENCE: The reference must look like SI00 … or RF.. (with valid check digits).
validation.INVALID_PURPOSE_CODE: The purpose code has 4 capital letters.
validation.SUPPLIER_PAYEE_REQUIRED: Enter the supplier's name and IBAN.
validation.EMPTY_MESSAGE: Write a message or attach a file.
validation.noticeDays: Enter a number of days from 1 to 730.
validation.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is too common. Pick another one.
validation.TERMS_REQUIRED: You need to accept the terms to sign up.

properties.newSubtitle: The house or building you rent out. You'll add flats in the next step.
properties.name: Name
properties.nameHint: What you call it, e.g. “Building in Vič”.
properties.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” with all its empty units?

units.title: Units
units.emptyBody: Add a flat or room you rent out.
units.name: Unit name
units.nameHint: For example “Flat 3” or “Room by the bathroom”.

tenancies.newSubtitle: Enter the terms once. Kvito prepares the rent from them every month.
tenancies.endHint: Leave empty for an open-ended tenancy.
tenancies.payeeHint: These details go on the UPN payment order your tenant receives.
tenancies.costsHint: Pick what you agreed on. Kvito assumes nothing.

splitHint.PERCENTAGE: You set a percentage for each tenant.
splitHint.PER_PERSON: The share depends on how many people each tenant represents.

tenancies.sharesMustTotal: Shares add up to {{total}} %. They must add up to 100 %.
tenancies.noTenantsBody: Send an invitation. Once accepted, they show up here.
tenancies.confirmEnd: End the tenancy? No new rent will be created.
tenancies.noticePeriodHint: In days, as written in the contract.
tenancies.rentReviewHint: In this month Kvito reminds you to review the rent.
tenancies.paymentNoteHint: Tenants see this next to the payment details. Kvito never receives money.
tenancies.depositHigh: The deposit is higher than three months' rent. Check that this fits the contract and the law.
tenancies.termsMoved: Rent, deposit, costs and closing the tenancy are in the tab

billingModeHint.COMBINED: The tenant pays one amount a month: rent and the cost advance together, with one payment slip.
billingModeHint.SEPARATE: Rent and the cost advance are two separate charges a month.

invite.title: Invite a tenant
invite.intro: Create a link and send it to your tenant, or show the QR code. They don't need to install an app.
invite.emailHint: Optional. If you enter it, we e-mail the invitation and only that address can accept it.
invite.sent: We sent the invitation to {{email}}. You can also show or copy it.
invite.showOrSend: Your tenant scans the code with the phone camera or opens the link.
invite.onceNote: You only see this link now. If you lose it, create a new one.

acceptInvite.title: Join the tenancy on Kvito
acceptInvite.noApp: No app needed. Everything works in the browser.
acceptInvite.emailMismatch: This invitation is for {{email}}. Sign in with that address.
acceptInvite.notFoundBody: The link may be mistyped. Ask your landlord for a new one.
acceptInvite.askNew: Ask your landlord to send you a new invitation.

state.ACCEPTED: This invitation has already been accepted

charges.lateBy_one: The due date passed {{count}} day ago.
charges.lateBy_other: The due date passed {{count}} days ago.
charges.kvitaBody: Your landlord has confirmed all your payments.
charges.emptyTenantBody: When your landlord posts rent or a bill, it shows up here with the payment details.
charges.waitingHint: You reported the payment. Your landlord still needs to confirm it.
charges.emptyLandlordBody: Rent is created automatically at the start of the month. Add a bill with “New charge”.
charges.reportedBody: Once your landlord confirms it, you'll see “Kvito ✓” here.
charges.disputedNote: This charge is marked as disputed. Sort it out in messages.
charges.rejectedNote: Your landlord can't see the payment yet: {{reason}}

payToHint.LANDLORD: The tenant pays you, to the IBAN in the tenancy terms. Each gets their own reference.
payToHint.SUPPLIER: The tenant pays the supplier directly, using the original bill's details.

charges.newSubtitle: A bill or another cost your tenant pays.
charges.uploadBillHint: PDF or photo. If it has a UPN QR code, we fill in the details for you.
charges.scanFound: We read the UPN QR code and filled in the details. Check them.
charges.scanNotFound: No UPN QR code found. Enter the details by hand.
charges.title: Title
charges.titleHint: As your tenant will see it, e.g. “Electricity October”.
charges.splitNote: The amount is split between tenants ({{method}}).
charges.purposeHint: Optional. If empty, we use the title.
charges.reportHint: Pay in your bank, then tap Paid.
charges.addFileHint: Add a payment slip or bill (PDF or image) so the tenant can see it with the charge.
charges.managedNote: This charge belongs to the contract (deposit or cost settlement). Change it in the tab

pay.qrLabel: UPN QR code for the payment
pay.qrHint: You can't scan a code with the phone that shows it. Copy the details into your banking app or save the code.
pay.emailed: We sent the payment details to {{email}}.
pay.supplierNote: You pay the supplier directly. Kvito never receives money.
pay.noMoneyNote: You pay in your own bank. Kvito never receives money.

qrUnavailable.PAYEE_ADDRESS_MISSING: No QR code: the payee has no address. Use the Copy buttons.
qrUnavailable.OTHER: No QR code for this payment. Use the Copy buttons.

pay.copyHint: Copy the details into your banking app.

upnTest.title: UPN QR test
upnTest.intro: Sample codes generated per the official standard (V15, ECC M, ISO-8859-2). Scan them with different banking apps and check the details.
upnTest.warning: The payee IBAN is fictional. Do not confirm a payment in your bank.
upnTest.step1: Open this page on a computer.
upnTest.step2: In your banking app choose “Pay with UPN QR” and scan the code.
upnTest.step3: Compare the details with the description and note what each bank shows.

messages.emptyBody: This is where landlord and tenants talk. You can also send a photo or a PDF.

systemEvents.DEPOSIT_DISPUTED: The tenant disagrees with the deposit return proposal.
systemEvents.SETTLEMENT_DISPUTED: The tenant disagrees with the cost settlement.
systemEvents.SETTLEMENT_CREDIT_CARRY_OVER: Settlement accepted. {{amount}} stays as credit until the next settlement.
systemEvents.SETTLEMENT_CREDIT_OFFSET_NEXT: Settlement accepted. {{amount}} is deducted from the next payment.
systemEvents.SETTLEMENT_CREDIT_REFUND: Settlement accepted. The landlord pays back {{amount}}.

issues.emptyBody: If something breaks, report it with a photo. Your landlord sees what's wrong and how urgent it is.
issues.newSubtitle: Describe what's wrong. A photo says more than a long description.
issues.title: Short title
issues.descriptionHint: Where, since when, and what you've already tried.

urgencyHint.NORMAL: Needs fixing within a few days.
urgencyHint.URGENT: Water leaking, no power or heating, danger.

meters.label: Meter label
meters.labelHint: Optional, e.g. “hot water” or the meter number.
meters.lowerWarning: This reading is lower than the previous one. Check the digits, or add a note if the meter was replaced.
meters.emptyBody: Enter electricity, water, gas or heat readings. A photo of the meter avoids doubts.
meters.footnote: Readings stay with the unit, even when tenants change.

documents.emptyLandlord: Add the contract, house rules or appliance manuals. You choose what tenants see.
documents.emptyTenant: When your landlord adds the contract or manuals, they show up here.
documents.title: Title

visibilityHint.TENANTS: Tenants can see and download it.

scopeHint.TENANCY: For example the contract or an annex.
scopeHint.UNIT: Stays with the flat for future tenants, e.g. appliance manuals.

handover.emptyLandlord: At move-in and move-out, record rooms, appliances, meters and keys together. Both confirm, both keep the PDF.
handover.emptyTenant: When your landlord prepares the move-in record, you review and confirm it here.

LANDLORD.DRAFT: Enter keys, meters and the state of the rooms, then send the record to your tenant for confirmation.
LANDLORD.AWAITING_CONFIRMATION: Waiting for your tenant to confirm the record.
LANDLORD.CONFIRMED: Both sides confirmed. The record can no longer be changed.

TENANT.DRAFT: Your landlord is still preparing the record.
TENANT.AWAITING_CONFIRMATION: Review the record. Confirm it if you agree, or send it back if something is off.
TENANT.CONFIRMED: Both sides confirmed. You can download the record as a PDF.

handover.confirmPrompt: Confirm the record? It can't be changed afterwards.
handover.reopened: The record is a draft again.
handover.noItems: No items yet. Add a room and its appliances below.
handover.itemName: Appliance or part of the room

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. When something happens, you'll see it here.

off.title: Reminders on your phone
off.body: Turn on notifications so Kvito tells you when a payment is due and when your landlord replies.

on.title: Notifications are on
on.body: This device gets reminders and updates. You can turn them off any time.

denied.title: Notifications are blocked
denied.body: Allow them in your browser settings for this site, then come back.

unsupported.title: This browser can't show notifications
unsupported.body: You'll get reminders by e-mail. For phone notifications, add Kvito to your Home Screen.

exports.title: Payments received
exports.body: A list of the payments you confirmed in the chosen year. For your accountant or your own records. Kvito is not a tax return.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: Kvito keeps only what it needs. Here you can download or delete all of it.
privacy.exportBody: Download a file with everything Kvito holds about you: profile, tenancies, payments, messages, meter readings and activity log.
privacy.deleteBody: We delete your name, e-mail, phone, devices and notifications, and sign you out everywhere.
privacy.deleteKept: Charges, confirmed payments and messages stay with the other side because they need them for their records. They will show as “Deleted user”. Landlords must end all active tenancies first.
privacy.typeEmail: To confirm, type your e-mail address ({{email}})
privacy.deleteConfirm: This can't be undone. Delete your account?

rent.title: Rent and terms
rent.hint: Enter the new rent as agreed or as the contract provides. Kvito does not calculate any index. The tenant is notified.
rent.saved: Change saved. The tenant has been notified.

deposit.title: Security deposit
deposit.tenantWaiting: The agreed deposit is {{amount}}. When your landlord sends the payment details, you'll find them among your charges.
deposit.startHint: Send the payment details, or record that you already received the deposit.
deposit.requested: The tenant got the deposit payment details.
deposit.heldTenant: At the end of the tenancy your landlord proposes the return. You confirm it.
deposit.disputeSent: Your landlord will get your answer.
deposit.acceptedToast: Thanks. Your landlord will return the agreed amount.
deposit.waitingLandlord: Your landlord will prepare a new proposal.
deposit.returnedToast: Recorded. The tenant will confirm receipt.
deposit.allKept: It was agreed that the whole deposit is kept.
deposit.proposalSubtitle: Deposit: {{amount}}. List what you keep and why. The tenant accepts or declines.
deposit.noDeductions: Nothing. The tenant gets the whole deposit back.
deposit.noteHint: Optional. E.g. when and how you return the money.
deposit.proposalFooter: Kvito doesn't move money. You return it yourself, then record it here.
deposit.proposalSent: The proposal was sent to the tenant.
deposit.rowsIncomplete: Each item needs a reason and an amount.

costs.title: Costs and settlement
costs.advancesHint: Advances are charged once a month, together, due with the rent. At the end of the period you settle them against the actual costs.
costs.noAdvances: Costs are not paid in advances.
costs.noAdvancesLandlord: No advances. If the tenant pays a monthly advance for costs, add it here.
costs.advancesEditHint: Monthly amount per cost. Applies from the next monthly charge.
costs.newSettlementHint: Pick the period. Kvito adds up the advances and the costs you entered month by month.
costs.advancesFromPeriod: Advances are recalculated for the chosen period when you save.
costs.dueDateHint: Once the tenant accepts, the difference appears among their charges.
costs.notePlaceholder: E.g. the building manager's statement for 2026 is attached.
costs.sent: The settlement was sent to the tenant.
costs.disputeSent: Your landlord will get your answer.
costs.waitingTenant: Waiting for the tenant to accept.
costs.refundedToast: Recorded. The tenant will confirm receipt.
costs.advancesHintCombined: The tenant pays rent and costs together, once a month. The settlement compares the advances with the actual costs.
costs.billingSaved: Saved. Applies from the next monthly payment.
costs.lumpSumHint: One monthly amount for all costs, e.g. €110.00. Applies from the next monthly payment.
costs.fromMonthsHint: Amounts come from the monthly costs. Correct them there; the settlement updates itself.
costs.noMonthsYet: No costs entered for this period yet.
costs.lineNotePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. per the building manager's bill

closeout.title: Closing the tenancy
closeout.hint: What is still missing for everything to be settled at move-out.
closeout.endedHint: The tenancy is closed. This is how it was left.
closeout.confirmEndNotReady: Something is still missing. Close the tenancy anyway?

moveOut.label: Move-out record
moveOut.pending: Prepare it in the Handover tab and confirm it together.

keys.label: Keys
keys.done: The number of keys is in the record.
keys.pending: Enter the returned keys in the move-out record.

settlement.label: Cost settlement
settlement.done: Settled up to the last advance.
settlement.pending: Prepare a cost settlement up to the end of the tenancy.
settlement.naConfigured: No advances have been charged yet, so no settlement is needed so far.

deposit.label: Deposit
deposit.pending: Propose the return and record it.

credit.label: Credit from settlements
credit.pending: The tenant has {{amount}} in credit. Pay it back and record it.

monthly.title: Costs by month
monthly.subtitleLandlord: Enter each bill when it arrives. The tenant sees the same table; the settlement builds itself.
monthly.subtitleTenant: Actual costs as the landlord enters them, and the advances you paid.
monthly.emptyTenant: The landlord has not entered any costs yet.

landlord.credit: The tenant currently has {{amount}} in credit.
landlord.owes: The tenant would currently pay {{amount}} extra.

monthly.informative: This is for information. It counts once the settlement is sent and accepted.
monthly.emptyMonthLandlord: No costs this month yet. Add them when the bill arrives.
monthly.emptyMonth: No costs entered for this month yet.
monthly.linkHint: Bills by month and the running balance

credit.question: You have {{amount}} in credit. What should happen with it?
credit.recommendLabel: What do you suggest for the credit?
credit.recommendHint: The tenant chooses; your suggestion is marked.

CARRY_OVER.title: Keep it as credit
CARRY_OVER.text: {{amount}} stays with the landlord and counts in the next settlement.

OFFSET_NEXT.title: Deduct it from the next payment
OFFSET_NEXT.text: {{amount}} is deducted from the next monthly payment.

toast.CARRY_OVER: Thanks. The amount stays as credit until the next settlement.
toast.OFFSET_NEXT: Thanks. The amount is deducted from the next payment.
toast.REFUND: Thanks. The landlord will pay the amount back.

state.CARRY_OVER: {{amount}} stays as credit until the next settlement.
state.OFFSET_NEXT: {{amount}} is still being deducted from the next monthly payments.

done.CARRY_OVER: The credit of {{amount}} went into the next settlement.
done.OFFSET_NEXT: The credit of {{amount}} was used for monthly payments.

credit.refundHint: For example when the tenancy ends.
credit.confirmRefund: Record that you paid {{amount}} back to the tenant?

bank.title: Bank statement
bank.entryHint: Upload a statement from your e-bank and Kvito recognises payments by their reference. You confirm them in one click.
bank.subtitle: Kvito finds incoming payments with a Kvito reference and links them to charges. You choose which ones to confirm.
bank.formats: camt.053 (XML) or CSV from your e-bank
bank.privacy: We don't store the file. It is only used to find payments; outgoing and other incoming transactions are not saved anywhere.

state.AMOUNT_UNKNOWN: The amount couldn't be read. Check before confirming.

bank.noMatches: No payments with a Kvito reference in this statement. Confirm payments without one on the charge itself.
bank.foreign: Some references don't belong to your tenancies ({{count}}). They are not shown.
bank.unmatched_one: {{count}} incoming payment without a Kvito reference
bank.unmatched_other: {{count}} incoming payments without a Kvito reference
bank.unmatchedHint: If one of these is a tenant's payment, confirm it on the charge.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: You will be signed out on all other devices.

legal.draft: Draft, in Slovenian only. Not yet reviewed by a lawyer and may change.

monthly.title: Costs by month
monthly.aria: Costs by month compared with the monthly advance

forecast.title: Estimate until {{until}}
forecast.advice: To come out even, we suggest a lump sum of {{suggested}} a month (now {{current}}).
forecast.adviceFine: The current lump sum of {{amount}} a month fits.
forecast.applied: The lump sum is {{amount}} a month, from the next monthly payment.
forecast.perTypeHint: Advances are set per cost type; change them in the Contract tab.
forecast.basisAverage: There is no data from last year for {{months}}, so the estimate is the average of the months so far. Winter can cost more.
forecast.basisLastYear: The estimate follows the same months last year.
forecast.estimate: This is an estimate, not a settlement.

annual.title: Yearly summary {{year}}
annual.subtitle: Money received by unit and month: rent apart from reimbursed costs and the deposit.
annual.returned: Paid back to tenants: deposit {{deposit}}, cost overpayments {{costs}}.
annual.empty: No confirmed payments in this year.
annual.disclaimer: Amounts are payments you confirmed in Kvito, sorted by payment date. The summary helps with your records; it is not a tax calculation or advice – ask an accountant or FURS what counts as rental income.
annual.entryHint: The yearly summary separates rent from reimbursed costs and the deposit, by unit and month.

history.title: Renting history
history.subtitle: Show a future landlord how you pay. Your landlords entered and confirmed this data in Kvito.
history.shareHint: The link shows only the summary below: no amounts, addresses or e-mail. You can revoke it any time.
history.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the link and copy it by hand.
history.onlyOnce: You see the link only now. If you lose it, create a new one.
history.confirmRevoke: Revoke the link? Whoever has it can no longer open it.
history.verified: Entered and confirmed in Kvito by landlords with a confirmed e-mail. Kvito does not verify who they are.
history.paymentsValue: {{onTime}} on time · {{late}} late · {{overdue}} open after due date
history.footnote: “On time” means paid by the due date. Only tenancies with landlords who confirmed their e-mail count. No amounts, addresses or contacts.
history.notFoundBody: The link expired or the tenant revoked it. Ask them for a new one.
